dish.title: Chicken Tinga Tostadas with Crema, Queso Fresco, and Avocado
dish.description: Chicken thighs poached with onion, garlic, and bay, shredded and simmered in a smoky sauce of crushed tomatoes, chipotles in adobo, sliced onion, and oregano, heaped on crisp corn tostadas with shredded lettuce, Mexican crema, queso fresco, avocado, and lime.

recipe_version.title: Chicken Tinga Tostadas with Crema, Queso Fresco, and Avocado
recipe_version.description: Chicken thighs poached with onion, garlic, and bay, shredded and simmered in a smoky sauce of crushed tomatoes, chipotles in adobo, sliced onion, and oregano, heaped on crisp corn tostadas with shredded lettuce, Mexican crema, queso fresco, avocado, and lime.

ingredients.name: white onions
ingredients.note: 1/2 for poaching, 1 1/2 sliced for the tinga

ingredients.name: chipotles in adobo
ingredients.display_name: chipotles in adobo (2 chiles plus 1 tbsp sauce) whose label lists chipotle peppers, water, tomato, vinegar, salt, sugar, onion, and spices

ingredients.name: corn tostadas
ingredients.display_name: corn tostadas whose label lists corn treated with lime, vegetable oil, and salt

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Halve one onion; slice one and a half onions thin and keep the last half for the pot. Peel the garlic.

steps.title: Poach the chicken
steps.body: Put the chicken, 5 cups water, the onion half, 1 garlic clove, the bay leaf, and 1 tsp salt in the covered 4-quart pot. Bring to a boil over high, about 8 minutes to come to a boil, then simmer gently until the chicken reaches 175 F, about 15 minutes. Lift out the chicken, save 1/2 cup of the poaching broth, and shred the meat with 2 forks.

steps.title: Blend and cut
steps.body: While the chicken poaches (overlap stated): blend the tomatoes, chipotles with 1 tbsp adobo, 2 garlic cloves, and the oregano until smooth. Shred the lettuce, crumble the queso fresco, slice the avocados, and cut the limes.

steps.title: Simmer the tinga
steps.body: Heat the oil in the 12-inch skillet over medium, about 1 minute. Cook the sliced onions until soft and lightly golden, about 7 minutes. Add the blended sauce and 1 tsp salt and simmer 5 minutes, then stir in the chicken and the saved broth and simmer until thick and clinging, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Top each tostada with lettuce, a heap of tinga, a drizzle of crema, queso fresco, and avocado. Serve with lime.

Compared with slow-cooker-ropa-vieja: Mexican chipotle chicken on tostadas, not Cuban braised beef over rice. Compared with crispy-chipotle-tofu-tacos: shredded saucy chicken on flat crisp shells, not crisp tofu in soft tacos.
